item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 06/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be windier over the coast of Guangdong today. There will be a few showers in the next couple of days. A replenishment of the dry northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China early to midweek next week. The weather will become fine over the region but it will be cooler in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.
